id: title:Gilbert09:stop repeating a repartition rewrite killed in place

review.posthog_relevance: Checks the warehouse ingestion workflow for zombie-worker recovery and checkpoint preservation, preventing redundant rewrites and activity budget waste.
review.reason: Adds checkpoint and attempt-row tracking, zombie-worker recovery, and a killed-attempt retry guard. P1.F3.H1 checks if a killed worker left the rewrite checkpoint advanced; if not, the retry does not re-run the rewrite, preserving the next sync's activity budget.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the existence of zombie-worker and checkpoint-advanced states not explicitly demonstrated in this hunk; the score assumes the implementation correctly handles these edge cases rather than the hunk alone proving the outcome.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a README and workflow implementation. No score assigned.
